heads.h: NEW on the dashboard Meetings tab
heads.first: Claude can now add items to the Lead Meeting, the Foreman Meeting and the Friday Strategy when Koy asks, this week or a week ahead. They show tagged Added, with "Added by Claude". Remove one like any

Needs you now also lists blocks a person placed that have a problem: a day with nobody on it, or one person alone. It says who and which day. A lead or foreman whose partner is off that day isn't list
Someone on leave in Simpro now shows as Off on the calendar, even if their time-off request in the app isn't approved yet. Before, they showed as open.

Warranty work books to the job's Warranty cost center. If Finish or Rough In is already invoiced, the booking goes to Warranty instead and the preview says so. If the job has no open Warranty cost cen
"How you schedule": a fold on the left with the rules Duet follows when it suggests blocks. Duet can propose a rule when it sees a pattern. Nothing counts until an admin taps Approve. Admins can also
The Forecast tab now opens on the crew calendar. The Crew Planner button is gone; the crew calendar replaced it. A small "Old Crew Planner" link at the end of the row still opens the old board if you
Fridays have a "Said yes" list. Tap "Add who said yes", tick the people, and their names show on that Friday to drag onto a job.
Book now refuses someone who is off, not on a crew, or on a holiday or weekend, even if the screen missed it.
Duet (Koy's assistant) can now suggest a block on the calendar. It shows with a dotted green outline and says "Duet suggests", with the reason.
A flag that would change a job's start date now says, before you tap Yes, whether the GC gets emailed.

heads.h: NEW for admins: copy and share Claude reports
heads.first: Dashboard, Claude tab, Reports: open a report and tap Copy. Pick Foreman / crew or Owners / admins, and Text or Email, then Copy and paste it anywhere.
If someone sends you a report link, open it on your phone, sign in if asked, and the report opens over the app. Copy text is at the bottom.

heads.h: NEW on the dashboard meetings (office and leads)
heads.first: The Scramble, Lead and Foreman Meetings fill themselves from the app the first time each week's meeting opens. Prefill again at the top makes a fresh one.
+ Photo under any item, and + Add a photo to this section under the notes. On a phone you can take one or pick one.

Tick someone who is busy for only part of a job's time and you now get their free hours as a choice. Example: Jacob is on another job 10 to 12, this job is 7 to 11. You can add Jacob and make this job
A job or trip that's already booked in Simpro for a day no longer also shows its old plan for that day.

The box that opens when you tap a job now always fits on the screen. Before, on a job low on the page, the Time buttons, Move, Book and Remove were cut off at the bottom. If the box is taller than the
Untick everybody on a job and it stays on its day in red, "Nobody on it". Tap it to add people.
Two half days on two jobs no longer show as double-booked.
The auto-schedule can no longer put someone on a job when they're already booked somewhere else that day. Two rare cases could still do it: a job that started late after a return trip and ran into an
Nobody can be double-booked anymore. If someone is already on a job at that time, or off, they're grayed out and can't be added, and Simpro booking refuses it too.
Every job on the calendar shows its time, like 7:00 AM–9:00 AM.

heads.h: FIXED for the office: pairs on the Crew Board
heads.first: Anyone can be paired with anyone now: a foreman with an apprentice, two leads, or people on different crews.
Approved time off shows on each day ("Off: names"). Nobody gets scheduled on a day they're off.

heads.h: NEW for the office: pairs on the Crew Board
heads.first: Settings › Crew Board: tap someone, then Paired with, to set who they go out with. A foreman, jr foreman or lead pairs with an apprentice or crew member on the same crew.
Tap + more on a busy day and that day's jobs open right over the calendar. Esc or a tap outside closes it.

heads.h: NEW for the owners: Friday Strategy on the dashboard
heads.first: Dashboard › Meetings has a fourth button, Friday Strategy · Fri 8:00. Only admins see it (owners and the office).
Edit under any row changes its words for that week's meeting. The job itself doesn't change.
